title: feat(nm2oridetz): signed-outgoing det orientation of 1-in 2-out at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Orientation convention #2 (unique-signed): require |O ∩ {+e_i,-e_i}| = 1 on each of the two O-axes, then Orient = sign det(m,o_j,o_k). On the SAME opposite z-probe cell as #7393 and #7427 this returns fail at all four probes, because every probe's O carries an opposite pair. Third distinct verdict pair from identical data.
